fields.description: Must be https: the API key travels in the request URL.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Customer API key from the Fulfillmen User Center (My Information, API interface). Read only: this connector never creates or changes anything in Fulfillmen.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Optional. Read stock from this warehouse code only; empty sums every warehouse on the account.
fields.label: Warehouse Code
Webhook URL
fields.options: Give Fulfillmen this URL: https://<this site>/api/method/alaiy_os_connector_fulfillmen.api.webhook.receive. Notifications only trigger a re-read of the inbound order or SKU named in them.

fields.description: Sent by Fulfillmen in the App-Key header. Required for the webhook to accept anything.
fields.label: Webhook App Key

fields.description: Sent in the Access-Token header. Checked only when set.
fields.label: Webhook Access Token

fields.description: Sent in the X-Customer-Code header. Checked only when set.
fields.label: Webhook Customer Code

fields.description: How often to pull incoming shipments, stock, products and outbound orders.
fields.label: Sync Interval

fields.description: Shipped outbound orders created within this many days are re-read for tracking. Orders still in progress are always read.
fields.label: Shipped Orders Look-back (Days)
